The lock-screen text is organization-specific and must be supplied explicitly.

The Locked enrollment definition and Yes option are exact, but Microsoft requires 40 settings in an ADE policy. The other required settings include organization-specific enrollment and Setup Assistant choices without template defaults, so a deployable standalone policy cannot be emitted without a complete explicit administrator decision model.
Exact typed Graph property hostPairingBlocked=true for supervised iOS/iPadOS devices.
Exact iOS compliance policy property securityBlockJailbrokenDevices=true.
The administrator explicitly supplies both the minimum OS version and build; no release value is guessed.
Bundled with the jailbreak compliance policy because every compliance policy requires its noncompliance action; gracePeriodHours is explicitly 0.
The administrator chooses 0-72 hours and supplies an existing Intune notification template ID.
This is a human remediation and monitoring task for devices already reporting noncompliant, not a policy setting. No JSON is emitted.
Exact tenant deviceManagementSettings property secureByDefault=true.
CIS permits 1 through 7 days; the administrator must choose explicitly.

administratorInputs.prompt: Choose the iOS/iPadOS minimum password length. CIS requires 6 or greater; Microsoft Graph permits 4 through 14.
Choose the maximum iOS/iPadOS inactivity time before the screen locks. CIS requires 2 minutes or less.
Enter the organization-approved If Lost, Return to lock-screen message.
Enter the organization-approved minimum iOS/iPadOS version for compliance, for example 26.0.
Enter the organization-approved minimum iOS/iPadOS build for compliance.
Choose when Intune sends the noncompliance email. CIS requires 72 hours (3 days) or less.
Enter the exact ID of an existing Intune compliance notification template.
Choose the compliance status validity period. CIS requires 7 days or less.
